# nuxt-backend-data: the API

The public names of the function tiers, queries and mutations, errors, search, workflows, uploads, share links, retention, tokens and the Convex components for counts, queues, cached actions, crons and migrations, each with the first sentence of its doc comment.

The file ships inside the package, so it describes exactly the version in `node_modules`. The
core skill, `nuxt-backend`, lists every public name in its own `references/api.md`.

## Auto-imported composables

| Composable | What it does |
|---|---|
| `getBackendError()` | Read a refusal out of anything a call threw or resolved with: a `backendError()` from a Convex function, the rate limiter's own `RateLimited` error, an auth client's `{ data, error }` result or its `error`, a Better Auth `APIError`, and any of these as an `Error`'s `cause`. |
| `useBackendClient()` | The base module's, from `nuxt-convex-module/client`, under a neutral name. |
| `useConnectionState()` | The base module's, from `nuxt-convex-module/client`, under a neutral name. |
| `useSearch()` | Reactive, debounced full-text search. |
| `useWorkflowStatus()` | Reactively track a durable Workflow's status. |
| `useShareLink()` | One row's share link: whether it has a live one and since when, read live, and the actions that turn it on (or mint a new one) and off, through `getShareLink`, `enableShareLink` and `revokeShareLink` of `backend/storage.ts`. |
| `useUploadField()` | The upload field without its markup: pick a file (by the button or by dropping it), upload it with the base module's `useUpload` through the upload URL `setupStorage` mints, then hand the storage id to your `claim`, where the deployment checks it. |

## Components

| Component | What it renders |
|---|---|
| `<ConnectionStatus>` | The live connection's state, in words, for a person: nothing while it is up; "Reconnecting…" once a drop has lasted `delay`; "You're offline." as soon as the browser is; and how many changes wait to be sent meanwhile. |
| `<UploadField>` | A labelled file field that uploads through the upload URL `setupStorage` mints, then calls `claim`, where the deployment checks the file. |

## Import paths

### `nuxt-backend/functions`

| Export | What it is |
|---|---|
| `BACKEND_ERRORS` | Every code the package throws, with the HTTP status an auth route answers it with and the validator its data is checked against where it is thrown. |
| `backendError()` | Build the error for a refusal: `throw backendError('forbidden', { reason: 'role' })`. |
| `getBackendError()` | Read a refusal out of anything a call threw or resolved with: a `backendError()` from a Convex function, the rate limiter's own `RateLimited` error, an auth client's `{ data, error }` result or its `error`, a Better Auth `APIError`, and any of these as an `Error`'s `cause`. |
| `RECENT_SIGN_IN_SECONDS` | How recent a sign-in a sensitive action takes, in seconds: ten minutes. |
| `SENSITIVE_ACTIONS` | The table, by Better Auth route (its path under the auth base path) or by scaffold function (`module:export`, as the client calls it). |
| `defineRetention()` | Delete a table's rows once they pass an age, a batch per transaction, until none is left. |
| `normalizeEmail()` | The address trimmed and lower-cased: the form to store and compare it in, so `Ana@Example.com ` and `ana@example.com` are one person. |
| `randomToken()` | A random token from the platform's secure random source: 32 bytes by default, written as 43 URL-safe characters (`A-Z a-z 0-9 - _`), so it goes into a path or a query as it is. |
| `sha256Hex()` | The text's SHA-256 as 64 lower-case hex characters, from its UTF-8 bytes. |
| `createFunctions()` | Every access tier of your backend, from one call in `backend/functions.ts`: each a drop-in `{ query, mutation, action }` that checks the caller before the handler runs. |
| `verifyHuman()` | Check that a call comes from a person, in a function of your own: a waitlist join, a contact form, a referral claim, any call that reaches the deployment over the live connection and never through the app's server. |

Types: `BackendError`, `BackendErrorArgs`, `BackendErrorCode`, `BackendErrorData`, `BackendErrorPayload`, `RetentionArgs`, `RetentionOptions`, `RetentionResult`, `SensitiveAction`, `SensitiveLimit`, `AuthorizationComponents`, `AuthorizationCtx`, `FunctionUser`, `AuthorizationWorkspace`, `CallerRule`, `FunctionWorkspace`, `FunctionDeclaration`, `FunctionsRateLimiter`, `FunctionsBilling`, `FunctionsComponents`, `CreateFunctionsOptions`.

### `nuxt-backend/search`

| Export | What it is |
|---|---|
| `search()` | A fluent, type-safe builder over Convex's native full-text search. |
| `defineSearch()` | Define a ready-to-call Convex search query from a search-index config. |

Types: `SearchConfig`.

### `nuxt-backend/workflows`

| Export | What it is |
|---|---|
| `setupWorkflows()` | Configure the Workflow component for durable, long-running, multi-step functions. |
| `defineEmailSequence()` | A durable, multi-step email sequence (onboarding drips, cancellation follow-ups): each step sleeps its `after` delay durably (survives restarts and deploys via the workflow component), then sends through the backend component's email module — delivery-tracked like every other transactional email. |

Types: `WorkflowId`, `WorkflowStatus`, `WorkflowComponents`, `EmailSequenceStep`.

### `nuxt-backend/storage`

| Export | What it is |
|---|---|
| `setupStorage()` | Checked uploads, expiring private URLs and share links on Convex file storage, kept in the `backend` component's storage beside one owner record per file: the orphan sweep, an account's export and its erasure see every file the app keeps. |
| `DEFAULT_ACCEPTED_TYPES` | The types `setupStorage` keeps by default: raster images whose metadata it strips. |
| `DEFAULT_MAX_FILE_SIZE` | The largest file `setupStorage` keeps by default: 10 MB. |
| `SIGNED_URL_TTL_MAX_MS` | The longest a signed URL works: seven days. |
| `SIGNED_URL_TTL_MS` | How long a signed URL works by default: an hour. |
| `sniffContentType()` | The type a file is, read from its signature (its first bytes), or `null` for one the package does not recognise. |
| `stripImageMetadata()` | An image's bytes without its EXIF, XMP, IPTC and GPS data, its container rewritten and its pixels untouched, so quality is unchanged: JPEG, PNG and WebP. |

Types: `FileOwner`, `StoredFile`, `ResolvedShareLink`, `ShareLinkState`, `MintedShareLink`, `StorageApi`, `StorageReadCtx`, `StorageWriteCtx`, `ShareCtx`, `ShareableOptions`, `StorageQuota`, `SetupStorageOptions`, `Storage`, `StorageComponents`.
